topic: Al-Baqarah 2:152: remember Allah, and be grateful
coreInsight: Al-Baqarah 2:152 joins remembering Allah with gratitude, and the next ayah names patience and prayer as the help to lean on.

hookVariants.text: When did you last remember Allah in a queue?

script.onScreen: Remembrance goes both ways. / One ayah. One lesson.

REFLECTION / The lesson / This ayah ties remembering Allah to gratitude. The very next one names what to lean on when life is hard: patience and prayer. Remembrance is not only for quiet days. It belongs in ordinary moments, too.
LIVE IT TODAY / Remember Allah on the commute or in a queue · Thank Him for one specific thing today · When the day gets heavy, turn to salah first
Remember Allah once more today. / Save this reminder
